title: Eval corpus run record
description: Documented shape of an eval/corpus/runs/<run-id>.json file, written by D365FO.Core.Eval.EvalCorpusStore.Append. One file per (case_id, run_id). Committed — the corpus is the evidence the eval-improver ranks failure clusters from, so it has to survive across machines and CI runs.

source.description: replay = `d365fo eval run` (deterministic, canonical_args). agent = `d365fo eval score` fed by the eval-runner agent driving the natural-language instruction by hand.

classification.description: A hypothesis recorded by the runner (replay leaves this null; the agent may pass --hypothesis), confirmed or corrected by the eval-improver before any fix lands. See docs/AGENT_EVAL_LOOP.md for the rubric.
